draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.38, the 28th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 4th of 27 at CB. He went 37th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Carlton Davis III. Testing standouts: vertical jump (88th percentile). Testing concerns: 10-yard split (10th percentile). College production: 8 passes defended in 2025, 10th of 27 CBs in his class with stats.
